correctness.rationale: With the six genuine 2×2 minors of the 2×4 Hankel matrix, independent symbolic expansion verifies the Klein quadric equation p01 p23-p02 p13+p03 p12=0 and gradient (p23,-2p13,p03+3p12,-2p02,p01). At a concrete Hankel rank-two point the three overlap equations on four row-change variables have rank three, proving the minors map birational to Gr(2,4) on a dense open. Gradient is linear projection from center [0:0:-3:1:0:0], whose Klein equation equals -3, giving generically separable 2:1 for odd char≠3 and 1:1 birational in char3 (also char zero degree2). In char3 the gradient ideal is five minors; x0,x4 and x2 charts give quartic C plus a reduced isolated P, with F(P)=-1 nonzero. Independently enumerated all projective GF3 and GF5 points to verify base sizes 5=4+1 and 6=6, but finite fields are not proof of saturated ideal over algebraic closure.
